auto.machineguidance.match.the.machine: Match The Machine To The Job
auto.machineguidance.the.wrong.machine: The wrong machine wastes fuel, time, and money. We help you weigh reach, lift capacity, ground conditions, and attachment needs so your investment earns its keep from day one.
auto.machineguidance.four.core.categorie: Four core categories, each built for a different kind of work.
auto.machineguidance.our.mini.excavators: Our mini excavators pair proportional hydraulics with rugged structural weight for precise trenching and excavation in tight access sites — no fragile electronics to fail in the field.
auto.machineguidance.the.stomp.class: The STOMP-class skid steers move material fast and swap attachments quickly, making them the workhorse of landscaping, hardscape, and site-prep crews.

auto.machineguidance.how.do.i: How do I choose between an excavator and a skid steer?
auto.machineguidance.choose.an.excavator: Choose an excavator for digging, trenching, and reach work; choose a skid steer for surface material handling, loading, and attachment versatility. Many job sites benefit from both.
auto.machineguidance.which.machine.is: Which machine is best for tight or residential sites?
auto.machineguidance.mini.excavators.and: Mini excavators and mini skid steers are built for confined access — they fit through gates and work close to structures without the footprint of full-size machines.
auto.machineguidance.can.one.machine: Can one machine run multiple attachments?
auto.machineguidance.yes.with.the: Yes. With the right mounting plate and hydraulic flow, a single machine can run buckets, augers, breakers, and more. See our Attachments Support guide for compatibility.
auto.machineguidance.do.you.help: Do you help size a machine to my workload?
auto.machineguidance.our.specialists.siz: Our specialists size machines to your soil type, lift needs, and duty cycle so you don't overpay for capacity you won't use — or undersize and stall the job.

auto.shippingdelivery.ensure.clear.truck: Ensure clear truck access, a firm offloading surface, and someone on site to inspect and sign for the unit. Larger machines may require offloading equipment.
auto.shippingdelivery.what.happens.if: What happens if my shipment arrives damaged?
auto.shippingdelivery.note.any.damage: Note any damage on the delivery receipt, photograph it immediately, and contact our logistics team the same day so we can open a freight claim and arrange resolution.

auto..every.konstructz.machine: Every Konstructz machine ships with a structural and powertrain warranty covering the frame, hydraulics, and diesel engine. Coverage length varies by model — full terms are on the Warranty & Returns page.

auto.warrantyreturns.each.machine.includ: Each machine includes structural, powertrain, and hydraulic coverage against manufacturing defects. Exact duration depends on the model and is listed on your purchase documents.
auto.warrantyreturns.how.do.i: How do I file a warranty claim?
auto.warrantyreturns.submit.your.machine: Submit your machine model, serial number, and issue details through Contact Support. Our service team reviews and responds with next steps, usually within one business day.
auto.warrantyreturns.am.i.eligible: Am I eligible to return my equipment?
auto.warrantyreturns.unused.units.in: Unused units in original condition may qualify for return within the stated window, subject to inspection. Custom-configured or operated machines are generally not returnable.
auto.warrantyreturns.approved.warranty.p: Approved warranty parts ship directly from our parts warehouse at no charge. Out-of-warranty parts can also be ordered through support at standard pricing.
auto.warrantyreturns.does.the.warranty: Does the warranty cover wear items?
auto.warrantyreturns.routine.wear.items: Routine wear items such as filters, teeth, and fluids are maintenance responsibilities and are not covered, but we stock genuine replacements for all of them.

auto.jobsiteready.practical.machines.des: Practical machines designed for construction, landscaping, material handling, and the kind of daily worksite tasks that fill the schedule when you're trying to finish a job.
auto.jobsiteready.every.unit.ships: Every unit ships configured for the work people actually do — trenching, grading, loading, hauling, and material handling — without long setup days or specialty tooling. Operators familiar with compact equipment can climb in and stay productive from the first hour.

auto.jobsiteready.tell.us.what: Tell us what the site looks like and we'll recommend the unit that gets the work done without overbuying.

auto.jobsiteready.foundation.prep.backfi: Foundation prep, backfill, demolition cleanup, and short-haul material moves — compact loaders and excavators built to share a trailer with the rest of your kit.
auto.jobsiteready.slim.bodies.retractabl: Slim bodies, retractable tracks, and clean-running engines for working close to fences, gardens, and finished surfaces without tearing them up.
auto.jobsiteready.pallet.forks.buckets: Pallet forks, buckets, augers, grapples — universal quick-attach plates so one base machine handles loading, sorting, and lifting.
auto.jobsiteready.steady.hydraulics.simp: Steady hydraulics, simple controls, and accessible service points so the machine you bought yesterday is still the machine you're running next year.
auto.longtermvalue.productivity.reliabil: Productivity, reliability, and better ROI — Konstructz equipment is selected so it stays useful, year after year, with less wasted time on the job.
auto.longtermvalue.equipment.that.earns: Equipment that earns its keep — built around productivity, reliability, and the kind of return on investment that holds up after the warranty period.
auto.longtermvalue.we.size.equipment: We size equipment for the job it'll actually do, recommend the configuration that keeps maintenance cost low, and stand behind the units we sell so productivity compounds instead of erodes. The cheapest machine on day one is rarely the cheapest machine over five years — and that's the math we help you run.

auto.longtermvalue.right.sized.hydraulic: Right-sized hydraulics, dependable engines, and well-matched attachments mean each engine hour moves more work than an under-spec'd alternative.
auto.longtermvalue.component.choices.and: Component choices and pre-delivery checks reduce the surprise failures that take a machine out of the rotation for a week.
auto.longtermvalue.standard.quick.attach: Standard quick-attach plates, accessible service points, and clear operator controls cut down on changeovers, training, and downtime.
auto.longtermvalue.we.re.transparent: We're transparent about total cost — purchase, parts, common consumables, and resale — so you can compare options on real numbers, not sticker price alone.

auto.qualityequipment.konstructz.machine: Konstructz machinery is hand-selected for durability, performance, and tough job-site conditions. Built to keep crews moving through demanding work.
Quality Equipment, Engineered for Real Work
auto.qualityequipment.every.machine.in: Every machine in the Konstructz lineup is hand-selected for durability, performance, and the kind of working conditions that punish lesser equipment.
auto.qualityequipment.we.don.t: We don't carry every machine on the market — we carry the ones we'd trust on our own job site. Each unit is checked, tested, and prepared at our Commerce, California warehouse before it leaves the lot, so the machine you receive is the same one we'd hand to our own crew.
auto.qualityequipment.browse.the.machine: Browse the machines built to deliver on this promise — mini excavators, skid steers, wheel loaders, and more, all checked and ready.
auto.qualityequipment.engines.hydraulics: Engines, hydraulics, and undercarriages are operated and verified before shipping. If a unit doesn't perform to spec, it doesn't ship.
auto.qualityequipment.cooling.sealing.an: Cooling, sealing, and protection are tuned for dust, heat, mud, and long working hours — not showroom shine.
auto.qualityequipment.universal.quick.at: Universal quick-attach mounts, accessible service points, and serviceable parts mean operators stay productive and downtime stays low.

auto.trusted.we.walk.through: We walk through operating capacity, dump height, attachments, and trailerability so the unit that arrives can actually do what you bought it for.
auto.trusted.operator.questions.attachme: Operator questions, attachment swaps, scheduled maintenance reminders, and shipping coordination — we stay reachable after the invoice clears.
auto.trusted.we.help.you: We help you source the right wear parts, filters, and attachments so consumables don't become weeks-long delays.

warranty.faq.how.a: Submit your machine model, serial number, and issue details through Contact Support. The service team reviews the case, asks for photos or video if needed, and responds with the next practical step.
warranty.faq.docs.q: What documentation do I need on file?
warranty.faq.docs.a: Keep your original invoice, the machine's serial number, and your delivery receipt. These three documents let us validate any claim quickly without back-and-forth.
warranty.faq.transfer.q: Can I transfer the warranty when I sell the machine?
warranty.faq.transfer.a: Warranty coverage is tied to the original purchase. Talk to our service team if you are selling — depending on the unit's age and condition we can sometimes assign the remaining term to the new owner.
warranty.journey.step1.sub: Send model, serial, purchase date, and a description of the issue through the contact form or call our service line.
warranty.journey.step2.sub: Our service team reviews your claim, asks for photos or a short video if needed, and confirms what the warranty covers.
warranty.journey.step3.sub: Once approved, you get a plan: parts shipped, partner service scheduled where available, or a remote troubleshooting walkthrough.
warranty.journey.step4.sub: Genuine replacement parts ship from our warehouse, or a service appointment is scheduled with one of our partners in your region.
warranty.journey.step5.sub: After the repair, we verify the unit is operating normally and close out the claim with documentation for your records.

guidance.faq.tracks.q: What's the trade-off between rubber and steel tracks?
guidance.faq.tracks.a: Rubber tracks are gentler on finished surfaces (driveways, lawns, asphalt) and quieter, but wear faster in rocky or abrasive soils. Steel tracks are tougher and last longer in quarry conditions but will mark soft surfaces. We pick based on where the machine will spend most of its hours.
guidance.faq.cab.q: Do I need an enclosed cab?
guidance.faq.cab.a: If you operate in cold weather, dust, or rain for full days, a heated/ventilated cab pays back in operator comfort and machine resale. For seasonal or short-shift work, an open ROPS canopy keeps cost down and visibility up.
guidance.stat.models.sub: Sized from compact to heavier work
guidance.journey.step1.sub: Trenching, lifting, loading, demolishing, crushing? Each job leans toward a different category — we start by understanding the dominant task.
guidance.journey.step2.sub: Clay, sand, gravel, broken rock, finished surfaces? Ground conditions dictate track type, ground pressure, and engine output.
guidance.journey.step3.sub: We match operating weight to your access, lift capacity to your load, and reach to your geometry. Bigger isn't better — right-sized is.
guidance.journey.step4.sub: Buckets, augers, breakers, thumbs, forks. We confirm hydraulic flow and coupler type so the attachment chain is buildable from day one.
guidance.journey.step5.sub: You receive a written spec sheet with the recommended model, attachment list, and an estimate. You decide — we never push.

chatbot.wrong.forkliftDig:
### Not the Right Machine

An electric forklift is designed strictly for **lifting and moving pallets** in warehouses, not digging.

For digging trenches or property work, you should look at a **TYPHON mini excavator** (like TERROR XI or TERROR XXV).

*Common mistake: Do not choose a forklift for digging.*
chatbot.wrong.rollerPallet:
### Not the Right Machine

A road roller is built exclusively for **compacting soil, gravel, and asphalt**, not lifting pallets.

For material lifting and pallet handling, choose a **TYPHON electric forklift** or a **skid steer loader with pallet forks**.

*Common mistake: A roller has no fork attachments.*
chatbot.wrong.excavatorPallet:
### Not the Right Machine

While mini excavators can lift logs with grapples, they are **not designed for forklift-style pallet stacking**.

For warehouse pallet stacking, choose a **TYPHON electric forklift** (VIGOR series). For outdoor ground pallet handling, choose a **TYPHON skid steer** (STOMP series) with pallet forks.

*Common mistake: Excavator geometry is poor for stacking flat loads.*
chatbot.wrong.loaderDig:
### Not the Right Machine

Wheel loaders and skid steers are excellent for **moving, grading, and bulk loading dirt**, but they cannot dig deep trenches.

For deep utility line excavation, look at a **TYPHON mini excavator**.

*Common mistake: Loaders scrape surface material; they do not dig trenches.*

attachments.introText: Expand what your loader, skid steer or excavator can do. Konstructz attachments are engineered around real jobsite wear, matched coupler setups, and hydraulic fitment checks so you can move between digging, lifting, breaking and sorting with confidence.
attachments.info.intro: An attachment is the difference between a one-job machine and a multi-job machine. The right work tool turns the same loader or excavator into a trencher, breaker, auger drill, grapple, or material sorter — so you get more billable hours per machine and spend less on rental, transport and fleet count.
attachments.info.benefit.1: High-tensile wear steel built for continuous daily cycles
attachments.info.benefit.2: Quick-attach and pin-on options matched to machine setup
attachments.info.benefit.3: Sized to common machine flow and pressure classes
attachments.info.benefit.4: Replaceable wear edges and teeth to extend service life
attachments.info.benefit.5: Backed by the Konstructz parts and support team
attachments.info.compatibility: Attachment fit depends on coupler style, pin size, machine weight class, hydraulic flow, pressure range, and any electrical requirements. Before ordering, send us your machine model and we will confirm the safest attachment path.
attachments.info.faq.1.q: Will Konstructz attachments fit other brands of machine?
attachments.info.faq.1.a: Many can be matched across compatible coupler systems. Confirm coupler type, pin size, machine weight class, and hydraulic flow with our team before you order and we will identify the right unit.
attachments.info.faq.2.q: What is the difference between standard-flow and high-flow attachments?
attachments.info.faq.2.a: Flow classes describe the hydraulic demand of a powered attachment. Running a tool on the wrong hydraulic setup can underperform, overheat oil, or shorten seal life. Always match the attachment to the machine before purchase.
attachments.info.faq.3.q: Can I run more than one attachment from a single hydraulic line?
attachments.info.faq.3.a: Not at the same time. With a quick-coupler you can swap between attachments in minutes — one line, one tool active at a time.
attachments.info.faq.4.q: Do attachments come with a warranty?
attachments.info.faq.4.a: Yes. Konstructz attachments carry a manufacturer warranty against defects. Wear parts (teeth, cutting edges, bits) are consumables and are not covered by the warranty but are kept in stock for fast replacement.

legal.policy.section.0.title: Product Information
legal.policy.section.0.body: Website product details are provided for buyer guidance. Final pricing, availability, configuration, freight, warranty, and purchase terms are confirmed through official KonstructZ quote documents.
legal.policy.section.1.title: Orders And Support
legal.policy.section.1.body: Order, delivery, warranty, return, and support requests should be handled through the support pages or by contacting the KonstructZ team directly.
legal.policy.section.2.title: Updates
legal.policy.section.2.body: KonstructZ may update website pages, product information, and policies as equipment availability and business requirements change.

about.testimonial.1.title: Seamless Online Purchase
about.testimonial.1.body: We ordered the Stomp V980 loader directly through their online checkout. The financing approval took minutes, and the machine was delivered to our site fully ready for deployment.
about.testimonial.2.title: Easy E-Commerce Compatibility
about.testimonial.2.body: Finding attachment options on this digital store is incredibly easy. We bought a trenching bucket online and had it shipped to our site. The specs check tool is 100% accurate.
about.testimonial.3.title: Fast Online Orders & Tracking
about.testimonial.3.body: Ordering heavy equipment online felt risky, but the support chat helped us select the right model. Secure checkout, easy real-time tracking, and fast delivery direct to our yard.
about.mobile.intro: At Konstructz, we make quality machinery accessible to small businesses and local farmers. With a carefully curated selection of reliable, low-cost equipment, we help projects get done efficiently—without breaking the budget. Based in California, our team is small, agile, and ready to assist 24/7 online.

about.hero.intro: Konstructz exists to put dependable construction machinery within reach of the people who actually swing the hammer — small contractors, landscapers, farmers, and family-run job shops. Every machine and attachment in our catalogue is chosen for daily-driver reliability, honest pricing, and serviceability you can plan around. Based in Commerce, California, with a small, accountable team and online support around the clock.
